an8.23:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Āḷaviyaṃ viharati Aggāḷave cetiye.
an8.23:1.2: Tatra kho Bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi . . . pe . . . 2.
an8.23:1.3: Sattahi bhikkhave acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgataṃ Hatthakaṃ Āḷavakaṃ dhāretha.
an8.23:1.12: Imehi kho bhikkhave sattahi acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgataṃ Hatthakaṃ Āḷavakaṃ dhārethā ti.
an8.23:1.14: idaṃ vatvā Sugato uṭṭhāyāsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi. 4.
an8.23:2.1: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya yena Hatthakassa Āḷavakassa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
an8.23:2.2: Atha kho Hatthako Āḷavako yena so bhikkhu ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Hatthakaṃ Āḷavakaṃ so bhikkhu etad avoca
an8.23:3.1: ‘sattahi kho tvaṃ āvuso acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgato Bhagavatā vyākato.
an8.23:3.10: Imehi kho tvaṃ āvuso sattahi acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgato Bhagavatā vyākato' ti.
an8.23:3.11: ‘Kacci 'ttha bhante na koci gihī ahosi odātavasano' ti?
an8.23:3.12: ‘Na kho 'ttha āvuso koci gihī ahosi odātavasano' ti.
an8.23:3.13: ‘Sādhu bhante, yad ettha na koci gihī ahosi odātavasano' ti. 5.
an8.23:4.1: Atha kho so bhikkhu Hatthakassa Āḷavakassa nivesane piṇḍapātaṃ gahetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
an8.23:4.2: Atha kho so bhikkhu pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an8.23:5.1: ‘idhāhaṃ bhante pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya yena Hatthakassa Āḷavakassa nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
an8.23:5.2: Atha kho bhante Hatthako Āḷavako yenāhaṃ ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
an8.23:5.3: Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante Hatthakaṃ Āḷavakaṃ etad avocaṃ:
an8.23:5.4: sattahi kho tvaṃ āvuso acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgato Bhagavatā vyākato.
an8.23:5.13: Imehi kho tvaṃ āvuso sattahi acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgato Bhagavatā vyākato ti.
an8.23:6.1: Evaṃ vutte bhante Hatthako Āḷavako maṃ etad avoca:
an8.23:6.2: kacci 'ttha bhante na koci gihī ahosi odātavasano ti?
an8.23:6.3: Na kho 'ttha āvuso koci gihī ahosi odātavasano ti.
an8.23:6.4: Sādhu bhante, yad ettha na koci gihī ahosi odātavasano' ti. 6.
an8.23:7.3: sante yeva attani kusale dhamme na icchati parehi ñāyamāne.
an8.23:7.4: Tena hi tvaṃ bhikkhu iminā aṭṭhamena acchariyena abbhutena dhammena samannāgataṃ Hatthakaṃ Āḷavakaṃ dhārehi, yad idam appicchatāyā
